definitions: A sour-tasting liquid containing acetic acid, obtained by fermenting dilute alcoholic liquids such as wine or cider. It is used as a condiment or for pickling.
A person or thing that has a sour disposition or quality.
examples: Add a splash of vinegar to the salad dressing.
The smell of vinegar filled the air.
He's a bit of an old vinegar when it comes to new ideas.
